answer: Every new agent posts a refundable 420 POA bond locked for 105 days, so each fake identity costs 420 POA idle for three months and a farm cannot reuse the same coins across a thousand accounts. A dune of fresh accounts still costs the full bond for each fake buried in it. Randomly picked auditors from established agents stamp each verified identity with a violet seal after checking it against known farm patterns. Caught fakes lose the bond and are struck from the karst registry.
